raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview #60834 brought the paged MXFP4 sparse indexer (dense path) to DeepSeek-V4 on ROCm gfx950. It was opt-in: ```bash --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "mxfp4"}' ``` Its measurements show the MXFP4 indexer is better than the FP8 one on almost every axis: - lower TTFT (up to -30.7%) and TPOT; - +9.2% KV cache capacity (68 B vs 132 B per compressed token); - near-lossless accuracy: GSM8K -0.16pt, and GPQA Diamond is unchanged at 0.7121. The results are copied below. This PR therefore makes MXFP4 the **default** indexer K cache dtype for DeepSeek-V4 (`model_type == "deepseek_v4"`, i.e. V4-Pro / V4-Flash) on ROCm CDNA4, and logs that it is enabled. ## Claims Nothing else changes: - CUDA, XPU and CPU behave as before; - DeepSeek-V4.1 keeps its current opt-in; - every other model is untouched. ## Validation ### Benchmark (from #60834, DeepSeek-V4-Pro) Fixed sequence length (`8k1k`, TP8, MTP=2): | Conc | Indexer | Output token throughput (tok/s) | Change | Mean TTFT (ms) | Change | Mean TPOT (ms) | Change | | ---: | :------ | ------------------------------: | ------: | -------------: | -------: | -------------: | ------: | | 1 | FP8 (old default) | 145.99 | — | 597.24 | — | 6.24 | — | | 1 | MXFP4 (new default) | 156.34 | 7.09% ↑ | 413.91 | 30.70% ↓ | 5.96 | 4.49% ↓ | | 4 | FP8 (old default) | 454.91 | — | 504.07 | — | 8.02 | — | | 4 | MXFP4 (new default) | 466.92 | 2.64% ↑ | 437.29 | 13.25% ↓ | 7.95 | 0.87% ↓ | | 16 | FP8 (old default) | 1020.90 | — | 744.88 | — | 14.51 | — | | 16 | MXFP4 (new default) | 1030.30 | 0.92% ↑ | 681.89 | 8.46% ↓ | 14.46 | 0.34% ↓ | | 64 | FP8 (old default) | 1629.53 | — | 1637.36 | — | 36.85 | — | | 64 | MXFP4 (new default) | 1656.28 | 1.64% ↑ | 1622.58 | 0.90% ↓ | 36.29 | 1.52% ↓ | Agentic replay (DP8, MTP=3, prefix caching): | Indexer | Output Token Throughput (tok/s) | Mean TTFT (ms) | Mean TPOT (ms) | KV Cache Capacity (tokens) | |---|---|---|---|---| | FP8 (old default) | 697.25 | 2,442.24 | 46.01 | 4,589,684 | | MXFP4 (new default) | 675.83 (3.07% ↓) | 2,321.05 (4.96% ↓) | 43.42 (5.62% ↓) | 5,010,749 (9.17% ↑) | - **Latency improves:** mean TPOT -5.62% and mean TTFT -4.96%. - TPOT is the most consistent signal: both MXFP4 runs (44.60 / 42.24 ms) had lower TPOT than both FP8 runs (46.98 / 45.03 ms). - TTFT varied by up to 13% between runs of the same configuration, so treat its gain as indicative. - **Output throughput is within noise (-3.07%).** On this workload it is driven mainly by the trace replay and by output lengths. - **KV cache capacity: +9.17%.** Peak KV usage stayed below 40% here, so this workload does not yet turn the extra capacity into throughput. Higher-concurrency or longer-context workloads should benefit more. ### Accuracy (from #60834, DeepSeek-V4-Pro) GSM8K: | Task | Filter | n-shot | Metric | FP8 (old default) | MXFP4 (new default) | Change | | ----- | ---------------- | -----: | ------------- | ----------------: | ------------------: | -------: | | gsm8k | flexible-extract | 5 | exact_match ↑ | 0.9492 | 0.9477 | -0.16% ↓ | | gsm8k | strict-match | 5 | exact_match ↑ | 0.9500 | 0.9484 | -0.17% ↓ | GPQA Diamond: | Indexer | GPQA Diamond | Empty Responses (reasoning over budget) | |---|---|---| | FP8 (old default) | 0.7121 ± 0.0323 | 13 / 198 | | MXFP4 (new default) | 0.7121 ± 0.0323 | 11 / 198 | - **Accuracy is unchanged on GPQA:** both indexers score 0.7121. Per question, 124 are correct in both runs, and the disagreements are symmetric (17 vs 17, McNemar p = 1.0). - **This exercises the indexer's long-context path:** reasoning traces run to tens of thousands of tokens, far past the 4096 tokens where sparse top-k selection starts. - **The GSM8K change is negligible** (< 0.2% relative). ## Details ---
Pull Request Checklist - [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

@@ -93,8 +93,9 @@ class AttentionConfig:
     indexer_kv_dtype: IndexerKVDType | str = "auto"
     """Data type for the sparse-attention indexer K cache. "auto" picks the
     model's default (bf16 for MiniMax M3, fp8 for the DeepSeek sparse
-    indexer). Quantized formats (fp8, mxfp4, nvfp4) require indexer kernel
-    support in the backend."""
+    indexer, mxfp4 for DeepSeek-V4 on ROCm CDNA4 with aiter). Quantized
+    formats (fp8, mxfp4, nvfp4) require indexer kernel support in the
+    backend."""
 
     indexer_sparse_logits: bool = False
     """DeepSeek V4.1 two-level indexer: score only the candidate blocks with

@@ -384,6 +384,40 @@ def get_rdna_version() -> int:
     return 0
 
 
+def _maybe_default_dsv4_mxfp4_indexer(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:
+    """Default DeepSeek-V4's sparse indexer K cache to MXFP4 on CDNA4.
+
+    aiter's paged MXFP4 indexer is faster than FP8 on MI350/MI355 (lower
+    TTFT/TPOT, ~9% more KV cache) with near-lossless accuracy. Only rewrite
+    "auto" and fall back to FP8 silently when the MXFP4 path can't run, so
+    configs that worked before never start failing.
+    """
+    hf_config = getattr(vllm_config.model_config, "hf_config", None)
+    if getattr(hf_config, "model_type", None) != "deepseek_v4":
+        return
+    attention_config = vllm_config.attention_config
+    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    if (
+        attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype != "auto"
+        or attention_config.indexer_sparse_logits
+        or get_cdna_version() != 4
+        # The MXFP4 indexer metadata builder rejects DCP/PCP.
+        or parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size > 1
+        or parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size > 1
+    ):
+        return
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+
+    if not rocm_aiter_ops.is_enabled():
+        return
+    attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype = "mxfp4"
+    logger.info_once(
+        "DeepSeek-V4 on ROCm CDNA4: using aiter's paged MXFP4 sparse indexer "
+        "K cache by default. Pass --attention-config "
+        '\'{"indexer_kv_dtype": "fp8"}\' to use the FP8 indexer cache.'
+    )
+
+
 @cache
 def get_rocm_version() -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
     """Return the installed ROCm release as (major, minor, patch), or None."""
@@ -1168,6 +1202,8 @@ def check_and_update_config(cls, vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:
             )
             scheduler_config.disable_chunked_mm_input = True
 
+        _maybe_default_dsv4_mxfp4_indexer(vllm_config)
